description: This file defines the JobService class, which provides methods to execute jobs and wait for their completion within the Fineract project. It interacts with external APIs and manages job execution lifecycle.

classes.name: JobService
classes.description: Service class to manage job execution and polling for completion.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a specified job via an external API.

methods.name: executeAndWait
methods.description: Executes a job and waits until it is finished.

methods.name: waitUntilJobIsFinished
methods.description: Polls the job status until it completes or times out.
